notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 'coat near the center' is the statue's bronze greatcoat -> material change to white marble. U2 recolor-replace -> modern LED street lamp. U3 facade window (tiny, ill-defined removal) retargeted to the police officer standing in front of the plinth. U4 tiny single sneaker retargeted to the blonde woman in the cream fluffy jacket (add a beanie). U3/U4 v2 masks by SAM3, verified.

difficulty.evidence_zh: 基座上雕像的青铜大衣、右侧高大的黑色灯笼路灯、基座前双手插兜站立的警察和穿米色毛绒外套的金发女子是四个不同对象。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留人物服装、建筑和广场设施。

spec.ref: the bronze greatcoat of the statue on the stone plinth

units.ref_zh: 石基座上雕像的青铜大衣
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将石基座上雕像的青铜大衣的材质改为白色大理石。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的材质改为白色大理石。
units.reason: Mask is the sculpted coat of the bronze statue, while many people below wear coats; ref now names the statue. A material change suits a sculpture better than painting it blue.

spec.ref: the tall black lantern lamp post at the right in front of the domed building
spec.payload: a modern slim LED street lamp with a curved arm

units.ref_zh: 右侧圆顶建筑前高大的黑色灯笼路灯
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右侧圆顶建筑前高大的黑色灯笼路灯替换为一盏带弯臂的现代细长LED路灯。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一盏带弯臂的现代细长LED路灯。
units.reason: The post is already a black Victorian lantern post, so 'black streetlight' was a near no-op; a modern curved-arm LED lamp is a real structural change.

spec.ref: the police officer standing with his hands in his pockets in front of the statue plinth

units.ref_zh: 雕像基座前双手插兜站立的警察
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除雕像基座前双手插兜站立的警察。
units.reason: Old target was one of dozens of facade windows (49x81 px) and removing a window is ill-defined. Retargeted to the clearly visible officer in front of the plinth (other officers stand at the left or in profile further right); v2 mask by SAM3 'police officer'.

spec.ref: the blonde woman in a cream fluffy jacket and light jeans walking at the lower right

units.ref_zh: 右下方穿米色毛绒外套和浅色牛仔裤行走的金发女子
units.instruction_ref_zh: 给右下方穿米色毛绒外套和浅色牛仔裤行走的金发女子戴上一顶红色针织帽。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一顶红色针织帽。
units.reason: Old target was a single 60x51 px sneaker called 'the shoes', with a white stripe on a white shoe. Retargeted to the whole woman (she has no hat) with a visible payload; v2 mask by SAM3 'woman'.
